lines.text: Your phone is hiding over fifteen billion tiny switches.
Guess how small one is. A hair? A blood cell? A virus?
A human hair? Way too big.
But the switch is even smaller.
Charge the gate, and electrons rush through. That's a one.
Cut the charge, and they stop. That's a zero.
Wire billions of them together, and they can do math, play music, and run your entire phone.
Right now, they're flipping billions of times a second, just so you can watch this.
So what should I break down next? Tell me in the comments.
